Grok is a powerful AI assistant developed by xAI. Designed to be maximally truthful, useful, and curious, Grok helps you get better answers, create faster, and understand the world in real time. Whether you need intelligent conversation, advanced research, coding help, or high-quality image and video generation, Grok delivers.

AI Assistant
Ask anything and get fast, well-reasoned replies. Have Grok do deep research on the web, solve complex problems in math, science, and coding, or analyze documents, photos, and links in the chat. This AI assistant turns complicated topics into clear, actionable insights and can handle multi-step tasks with strong reasoning.

Grok Imagine – AI Image and Video Generation
Experience fast and powerful AI image and video creation. Generate striking images from text, create short videos with sound, or turn your photos into dynamic videos. You can even generate images using just your voice. Edit existing images by removing objects, changing backgrounds, or applying artistic styles — all with precise control and high quality.

Grok Voice Mode
Have natural voice conversations with Grok. Talk to your AI assistant and receive human-like replies in real time. Personalize how you interact and choose different conversation styles that match your needs.

Real-Time Information from X
Get the most up-to-date answers. With direct access to X and the web, this AI assistant keeps you informed about the latest news, trends, and conversations happening right now. Ask Grok to perform advanced searches on X and discover what people are really saying.

Easily Transfer Context to Grok
Already using ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or other AI tools? Easily transfer your conversations and context to Grok so you can continue working without starting over.

Real-World Use Cases
Students use Grok to study and get clear explanations. Professionals rely on it for research, writing, analysis, and problem-solving. Content creators generate custom images and videos in seconds. Developers get strong coding help and technical insights. Anyone who wants a fast, truthful, and creative AI assistant can benefit from Grok.

Who Is Grok For?
Grok is built for curious people who want more than basic answers. It’s perfect for students, professionals, creators, researchers, and anyone looking for a powerful AI chat experience combined with advanced image, video, and agent capabilities. If you value truth-seeking, creativity, and real-time knowledge, Grok is made for you.

With Grok as your personal AI assistant, navigating knowledge, sparking creativity, and getting real work done becomes faster and more exciting. Download Grok today and experience what a truly helpful AI can do.
